verdict.rationale: Baseten documents an official MCP server ('Install the Baseten skill and MCP servers so your coding agent can manage your Baseten workspace and search these docs') and a probe confirms the setup page at docs.baseten.co/agent-setup exists, so agents can connect via a first-party MCP server. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of the MCP server working, and more detailed documentation of its tool surface/configuration.
